headline: OpenDDE: Open-Source AI Foundation Model for Drug Discovery
reasoning: This paper introduces OpenDDE, an open-source, all-atom biomolecular foundation model for drug discovery, which is highly relevant to AI/ML and represents a significant development in the application of AI to a critical field. The release of training code, checkpoints, and benchmarks from Aureka AI OpenDDE project lends strong technical credibility and promotes collaborative research, moving beyond mere speculation.
summary: Aureka AI has released Open Drug Discovery Engine (OpenDDE), an open-source, all-atom biomolecular foundation model designed to accelerate drug discovery through scalable AI-driven co-folding and structural reasoning, complete with reproducible resources.

source_articles.title: Folding, Reasoning, and Scaling with Open-source Drug Discovery Engine
source_articles.excerpt: arXiv:2607.03787v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurately modeling biomolecular interactions is a central bottleneck in biology and therapeutic discovery. Here, we introduce Open Drug Discovery Engine (OpenDDE), an open-source, all-atom biomolecular foundation model that uses co-folding as the entry point to a scalable AI-driven drug discovery engine.
